settings.boundary: A finite synthetic recovery screen, not a population guarantee or human evidence for persistent encoding. Covariance separation alone is insufficient for discrete code distributions.
settings.criterion: Report three-by-three confusion matrices, parameter-grid recovery and log-score differences. Distinguishable_on_registered_screen requires each family's diagonal recovery fraction over its nine generating settings to have Wilson 95% lower bound above 1/3, and unchanged winning family for all settings under the integration-budget check. Otherwise persistence specificity is unresolved; behavioral sufficiency testing may still proceed.
settings.generation: All three codecs at every eta/gain grid point, on the same 64 non-Liu held-out generic episode designs; draw original admission latents and codec randomness, then ten choices per unordered query from each fixed terminal state. No fitted-model selection.
settings.recovery: Grid-marginal model likelihood with a uniform prior over the nine declared eta/gain settings. Integrate unobserved admission and encoding using separately drawn common nuisance samples from the unchanged generative laws. Decoder sees only ordinary cues, observed support values/order and terminal choices; never the generating z, code, w or true rank. Repeat at 1024 nuisance draws without selecting whichever result is better.
settings.stage: Non-Liu synthetic recovery screen after implementation qualification/source lock and before mandatory training. No Liu behavioral evaluation or parameter tuning at this stage.
